title: Money or tomorrow's effort
hook: Two stated cases: explore different model weights for different reward domains.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How different model weights for different reward domains affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare different model weights for different reward domains in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model values immediate 10 normally, but delayed 12 after 1 periods as Beta 0.9 times Delta 1 to the delay. What is delayed minus immediate value?
